coordinate_system: origin top-left; x right,y down; native PNG pixels; uncertainties are manual conservative hypotheses, not measured statistical errors

warning: Silhouette extrema and projected ellipse centers are view-dependent. Do not assign identical 3D points across views. Rounded bar tangencies are curve constraints. No brightness transforms applied.
